velachery.report: Heavy rainfall has continued since afternoon. Water near Velachery MRTS is reported to be knee deep, traffic movement has stopped, and several elderly residents are unable to leave their homes.

chromepet.report: Heavy rain has resulted in water accumulation on a residential road in Chromepet. Vehicles are moving slowly and residents report water approaching the entrances of some houses.

tambaram.report: Strong winds and persistent rainfall are affecting Tambaram. A tree is reported to have fallen across a local road and electricity supply has been interrupted in parts of the area.
